prior_failed_attempt.failure: Both pre-physics launches exited 174 in wrf_global_to_patch after about 1.4 seconds; no histories or timestep completion. The parent process inherited an 8192 KB stack soft limit because the legacy env.sh unlimited-stack setting was omitted.
prior_failed_attempt.interpretation: Environment/setup failure, not a forecast or physics result. The old failed receipts/logs and copied sources are preserved.

six_hour_namelist_contract.detail: One exact value each is required for run 12–18 UTC, 20 s timestep, and hourly history outputs; wrong and duplicate settings reject.

private_89_input_copy.detail: Test confirms exact 89-file input set copied to distinct inodes, each hash matches, and repeated prepare refuses existing case without changing prepared.json.

existing_launcher_guard.detail: Test confirms an existing launcher.log rejects run before launch and leaves it unchanged; no run receipt is written.

limited_hard_stack_refusal.detail: Controller refuses a finite stack hard limit before opening launcher.log or launching MPI; no setrlimit mutation is attempted.

unlimited_stack_in_rank_wrapper.detail: The success fixture enters the rank wrapper with both stack limits unlimited; the wrapper records and accepts the setting before exec.

rank_affinity_guard.detail: Wrapper accepts a single correctly pinned rank and refuses rank 8 before executing wrf.exe.

case_cpu_sets.detail: SHAM_A 0–7 and SHAM_B 8–15 are disjoint; grouped cases use separate 32–39 and 40–47 sets.

review_observations: The controller checks the pinned IFX executable and runtime libraries, frozen build receipt, MPI binary, source receipts, private input hashes, per-rank affinity, all-rank success markers, and seven exact finite histories before passing a run.

The controller now requires an unlimited stack hard limit, sets both soft and hard stack limits unlimited before MPI launch, and records before/launch limits in the run receipt. Each rank wrapper independently requires an unlimited soft stack before exec.
Process tracking records PID start ticks to avoid PID-reuse confusion and attempts process-group cleanup on timeout/interruption and when sampled descendants remain.
Run receipt does not itself hash launcher.log, rsl.out.* or affinity_rank*.json. The final evidence manifest should bind those files if they are retained as run evidence.
limitations: Review and tests did not prepare or launch either retry model run.
GO applies only to OLD_SHAM controls SHAM_A/SHAM_B; it does not authorize grouped C/D runs or establish forecast/scientific validity.
The actual grouped operation and compiled WRF instruction ordering remain separate native-owner gates.
